1.why: Visible labels use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable spacing on an uncluttered screen.

2.why: No italics, all-caps, or dense text blocks appear; only brief plain labels are shown.

3.why: The narrow, sparse layout is clearly sized for a mobile viewport and remains readable.

4.why: The sole message 'Loading secure setup...' is short and in plain language.

5.why: No input fields or examples of expected input are present on this screen.

6.why: The user is not required to read any long block of text; only a brief loading phrase is shown.

7.why: No long codes or secrets are displayed, so copy-to-clipboard cannot be used.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry is offered.

9.why: No input fields exist for browser autofill or password managers to act on.

10.why: A loading state is shown without a clear step indicator or distinct primary action.

11.why: No actions are requested, so single-action focus is neither violated nor clearly demonstrated.

12.why: The screen only says it is loading and does not state what happened or what comes next.

13.why: No codes, reveal/hide controls, or retry options are present.

14.why: No error messages are shown at all.

15.why: No reading or entry time limits or countdowns are imposed on this screen.
